title: Zulu Kingdom (c. 1816-1897)
key_facts: Powerful African kingdom founded by Shaka Zulu
Known for military innovation and short stabbing spear (iklwa)
Defeated British at Battle of Isandlwana (1879)
Eventually conquered by British superior firearms
causes: Shaka's military reforms and conquest strategies
Population pressure and competition for resources
outcome: Zulu victory at Isandlwana shocked British Empire
Legacy of African resistance and cultural pride

figures.name: Cetshwayo
figures.role: King who defeated British at Isandlwana

impacts: Delayed British expansion in southern Africa
